limitations: Coverage is Cua Viet source area only, not all Vietnamese ports.
Records are authority notices, not AIS-confirmed movements.
No IMO is supplied; identities remain scoped to observations and are not merged by name.
Missing or invalid time remains quarantined; partial coverage is not treated as zero activity.
No canonical terminal/berth assignment is inferred for this source area.
Direct source access can fail transiently; authenticated bundle import is the tested fallback.
No recurring refresh schedule or full historical backfill is configured.
Raw source redistribution rights are not marked approved; public output contains selected structured facts only.
